about: A slender frilled dinosaur that rattles its frill, hisses and spits venom.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A frilled dinosaur gives warbling cooing trills and clicks, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A frilled dinosaur hisses and rattles its frill like a rattlesnake, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A frilled dinosaur shrieks in pain, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A frilled dinosaur gives a weak warbling dying cry, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A frilled dinosaur hisses and spits a wet glob, five separate spits with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Light clawed footsteps of a small dinosaur on earth: quick taps, well spaced. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
